# strictcode fix

Apply tier-1 (guaranteed behavior-preserving) fixes with post-fix graph re-verification

**Effect:** mutating

**Dry run:** not supported — the file rewrites happen inside the fix package's apply-and-verify path, outside the effects handle; pass --preview to list the planned fixes without touching a file

## Flags

| Name | Short | Type | Presence | Env | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` |  | str | optional |  | Config file name, resolved relative to the analyzed directory; omitted means strictcode.toml |
| `disposition` |  | choice | required |  | Selection (not typed as a flag). Elect exactly one of `--apply`, `--preview`. What to do with the planned fixes |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`--apply` |  |  | required |  | Elects `disposition` = `apply`. rewrite the files and verify the result against the declared delta |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`--preview` |  |  | required |  | Elects `disposition` = `preview`. list the planned fixes and touch nothing |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | str | optional | Project or workspace root; omitted means the current directory |
